title: Recycle Bin Feature Released
message: Accidentally delete a note? Don't panic! Notes now go to the **Recycle Bin** where you can preview, restore, or permanently erase them.

title: Dynamic Palette & Fonts
message: Explore the new **Palette** menu to personalize wall colors and note typography with live header preview support.

title: Home Screen Widgets Deep Dive
message: Pin your most important sticky notes directly onto your Android Home screen. Tap the **Widget Pool icon** on any note to get started.

title: Reddit Community Now Live!
message: Join our official subreddit **r/DigitalStickyNotesApp** to discuss setups, suggest new features, and connect with other users!

title: Distraction-Free Clean Wall View
message: Need pure focus? Tap **Clean Wall View** in Settings to hide all buttons and navigation bars. Tap anywhere to bring them back.

title: Backing Up Your Sticky Notes
message: All notes stay on your device! Use **Export Backup** in Settings to save your notes safely to Google Drive, SD Card, or another app.

title: Pro Canvas & Freehand Drawing
message: Turn any sticky note into an art sketch! Switch to **Art Mode** for precision drawing, highlighter strokes, and custom colors.

title: Checklist Notes & Task Tracking
message: Create actionable checklists with strike-through toggles, custom fonts, and draggable reordering.

title: Folders & Stack Management
message: When Folders are disabled, look for the compact **unlink icon** next to Folders in Settings to instantly dilute all stacks into independent notes.

title: Hermes & Physics Performance
message: Enjoy ultra-smooth 60fps drag physics, instant canvas panning, and zero input lag powered by our optimized rendering engine.

title: Washi Tape Styles & Patterns
message: Give your digital wall an authentic scrapbook aesthetic with realistic washi tapes, polka dots, grids, and stripes.

title: 14 Languages Fully Supported
message: Digital Sticky Notes is fully localized in 14 languages! Change languages anytime from the globe icon in Settings.

title: Daily Card Review Mode
message: Swipe through your notes flashcard-style in **Review Mode** to quickly plan your day or study key points.

title: Direct Feedback & Diagnostics
message: Experiencing an issue? Tap **Send Feedback** in Settings to email the developer directly with automatic diagnostic headers for fast resolution.

title: Gestures & Fast Canvas Navigation
message: Double tap to zoom, pinch to inspect details, and long-press notes to bring them to the top layer.

title: Harmonious Wall Themes
message: Choose between Corkboard, Slate Dark, Sky Blue, Matcha Green, Lavender, and warm parchment backgrounds.

title: Our Strict Privacy Commitment
message: Zero trackers. Zero telemetry. No user accounts. Your data never leaves your device.

title: 100% Offline by Design
message: Take notes on planes, subways, or in the woods. Digital Sticky Notes never requires an internet connection to work.

title: Follow Us on Instagram
message: Tag **@digitalstickynotes.app** to showcase your creative canvas setups and desk workspaces!

title: Quick Start Guide
message: New to the app? Tap the **+** button to create your first sticky note. Choose a color, pick a font, and start brainstorming!
